capabilities: : Edit diagrams using a graphical editor
disambiguation: It is a code-based system for generating and verifying architecture diagrams, not a general drawing tool.
extras: The plugin is closed source and also available as a Confluence app.
intentEvidence: A drawing can say anything. Boxes get copied, arrows point to systems that were renamed long ago, and nobody can tell what is real.
motivation: To ensure diagrams are verifiable evidence by enforcing that every visual element is derived from and validated against a strict data model.
problem: Traditional architecture diagrams are prone to manual errors and inconsistencies, making them unreliable evidence in reviews.

relations.evidence: a macro renders a code block of the page live and edits it with the same editor.

summary: TrustDiagram converts YAML code blocks into verifiable architecture diagrams, ensuring the visual representation matches the underlying data model.
